targets.quality_label: Noether Paper 02 RA65 German final consolidation audit, no-patch source trap
targets.coverage: Paper 02 German cumulative block in the RA64 base, lines 418-3430. The package inventories tag anchors and environment balance, checks prior RA31/RA34 table-fix propagation, checks RA28 Greek-nu versus Latin-v rebasing traps, and includes one 1000dpi inspection slice for printed p.66.
targets.findings: No new source-confirmed TeX patch. The remaining concrete suspicion was that a body display `L_j^2` near Section 14, System III, might be contamination from the known separate Table I row-10 correction. The source slice confirms that the body display has `L_j` on the first row and `L_j^2` on the second row, so the current body reading should not be changed by analogy with the table correction.
targets.limitations: This is an audit/drop package only. It deliberately does not produce a patched TeX file. It is not proof that every Paper 02 symbol in every language branch is globally certified, not a whole-corpus source closure, not a critical edition, and not multilingual propagation. The 1000dpi image is an inspection enlargement from a GDZ page image whose native source is about 400dpi.
targets.next_action: Upload with the next Noether source-audit/provenance Zenodo version, then update record IDs, metadata JSON, public catalog, generated record pages, and status docs. Carry the L_j/L_j^2 finding as a no-patch trap in future branch reconciliation and multilingual propagation.
